text:
Marco Rossi came to Vancouver in the December 2025 blockbuster that sent Quinn Hughes to Minnesota, which means every Rossi stretch gets read as a verdict on that deal. This one is hard going. He has seven points in 18 games and no goals in his last ten, and his ice time has dropped to 14 minutes a night over that stretch, about three fewer than before.

It isn't for lack of trying. He put seven shots on goal in Winnipeg on Nov. 5, and his three goals sit right on 3.1 expected. His scoring rate (1.51 points per 60) is below the bottom of our talent range for him, which usually points to a player who will find more, not one who has lost it. Last season Evolving-Hockey had him at 1.6 wins above replacement, much of it on the power play, while skating with teammates in the bottom 8%. Corey Sznajder's All Three Zones tracking had 70% of his exits leaving the zone with possession. Those are the skills of a useful center, and a team that has lost nine of ten needs them back.
headline: Marco Rossi is searching in Vancouver
